offers.description:
Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform driving digital commerce across the globe. By offering a fully integrated solution, we empower marketers, online stores, and digital agencies to manage, scale, and optimize their online activities.

As the market leader in the Benelux, we owe our success to an incredible product, a passionate team ánd our customers who love working with us! To keep winning, our Benelux region is split into two specialized teams (Strategic and Growth), working closely together.  This opening is within the CS Benelux Strategic team.

Your role in a nutshell: you'll own Channable's most strategic Benelux relationships: (inter)national brands with digital marketing teams in the region, and our biggest Agency Partners (Gold & Silver). You'll work with senior specialists, marketing leads, heads of e-commerce, and decision-makers to understand what their business is trying to achieve this year and how their digital marketing team is measured against it. From there, you find where Channable can drive the outcomes that get them closer to those goals. When your clients win, and Channable is a part of that, we grow together, and that growth is you

offers.description:
About the role 

We are looking for a true hiring partner for our operations and commercial teams. Culture is critical for our success and you will help shape it. Do you enjoy building strong partnerships by advising and guiding hiring managers and candidates across multiple markets? If so, this is a role for you! 

In this role, you’ll manage the full hiring cycle for your own designated departments, where you have a lot of ownership to evolve their hiring engine. You will hire across our main office in Utrecht as well as our offices in the US, Denmark & Berlin. That means you will navigate between different business needs, hiring cultures and candidate expectations, while providing a great experience for everyone involved. 

Our People Team consists of 3 sub-departments; Talent Acquisition, Employee Experience and HR. Over the years we built a strong foundation, so you will not start from scratch. This role is for someone who can easily step into existing processes but also proactively challenges what can be improved. 

If you love hiring and want to grow in a team where your voice matters, we’d love to hear from you.
offers.locations_question: What is your preferred work location?
offers.requirements:
About you 

You take pride in the quality of your work and care deeply about the candidate experience. You are structured enough to follow the process but also know when to be flexible. Speed matters to you but not at the expense of quality. 

You work well in a team, and bring energy and enthusiasm to your work. You share what you learn, ask for feedback and show curiosity about the industry and how tools and AI can raise the bar. 

You know that hiring is not just about matching a CV, but also about having a strong understanding of the business, team dynamics and finding the best fit. 

What You’ll Bring 

  • 3-5 years recruiting experience (preferably in-house), ideally in a fast-moving, dynamic environment. 

  • Proven track record in hiring across commercial and operations functions. 

  • Experience in hiring across multiple countries or markets. 

  • Strong stakeholder advisory skills; you can challenge hiring managers while keeping a good relationship.

offers.description:
Do you speak French fluently and are you passionate about solving complex problems for a diverse range of customers? Do you want to help ecommerce businesses grow by delivering high-quality technical support? Then this role might be for you!

You’ll be joining our international Support department, which consists of 5 teams supporting 9+ markets worldwide. Within this global setup, you’ll work in our Southern Europe & International inbox, supporting customers across multiple markets including France, Iberia, Italy, the UK, and beyond. Your French language skills are essential to ensure strong support coverage for our French-speaking customers, while your role will extend across the broader international scope.


We’re an open-minded and collaborative team of Support professionals. We believe Support isn’t just about fixing problems, it’s about setting our customers up for success, and we do this together. We learn from each other, keep things honest and direct, and enjoy the occasional fun moment along the way. Expect flat hierarchies, room for your ideas, and a team that’s got your back!

offers.sharing_description: Channable powers product feeds and digital advertising for 14,000+ brands and agencies across 3,500+ channels. We're a market leader entering our next phase of North American growth.  We need an AE wh
offers.description:
Channable powers product feeds and digital advertising for 14,000+ brands and agencies across 3,500+ channels. We're a market leader entering our next phase of North American growth.  We need an AE who knows eCommerce technology, builds real relationships, and wants to own a market, not just a quota.

The opportunity

Our North American business is growing fast. The team is small, the market is massive, and the company has the product maturity and global footprint to back serious ambition. You'll have direct influence on how we go to market, who we target, and how we win.

We sell to eCommerce operators and the agencies that serve them. Our buyers care about product data, feed quality, and operational efficiency. If you've sold into the infrastructure layer of eCommerce (the systems that make products show up correctly, everywhere, at scale), you'll feel at home here.

Your role

Full-cycle Account Executive. You build a pipeline, run your own process with help from solutions engineering and Technical Account Management, and close.
offers.locations_question: What is your preferred work location?
offers.requirements:
Who you are

  • 3+ years closing new business in B2B SaaS, ideally in eCommerce technology, feed management, product data, or martech.

  • You understand the eCommerce tech stack, including platforms, ERPs, PIMs, marketplaces, advertising channels, and can hold a real conversation about how products get from a back-end system to a customer.

  • You've sold to operations-minded buyers (eCommerce Ops, Digital Merchandising, Catalog teams), not just marketing personas.

  • You're energized by early-stage markets where your work directly shapes the company's trajectory.

  • You qualify out as confidently as you qualify in.

Bonus points

  • Existing network in the eCommerce agency ecosystem.

  • Experience migrating customers off competitor platforms.

  • Familiarity with Google Shopping, Meta product feeds, TikTok Shop, or marketplace listing workflows.
